mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/cache-eviction.md <<'EOF'
# Cache Eviction Policy

The project's current recorded decision is to use an LRU (Least Recently Used) eviction policy for caching, together with a 300-second (5-minute) TTL: when the cache reaches capacity the least-recently-used entries are evicted, and entries expire automatically after 300 seconds regardless of how often they are accessed.
EOF
cat docs/policies/cache-eviction.md
